errors.evidence: The blue line (Lithuania) ends at the labeled point (83.2, 79.6). The description gives an incorrect endpoint (80, 81.6), using a value from the gray line, and hallucinates a peak at (50, 72.3) using a value from the orange line.
The labeled endpoint for the gray line (Estonia) is (81.6, 66.5). The description reports the x-coordinate as 80 instead of the correct 81.6.
